listing.name: Persona 3 FES — fes-pc-recomp (Virtual-AK)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the opening, town and first dungeon floors. Its rough 83% estimate does not establish full-game support. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U SLUS21621 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s local setup and launcher instructions with your own disc. One-step setup on a clean PC and full-game testing remain unfinished.

warnings: Upstream reports the opening, town and first dungeon floors. Its rough 83% estimate does not establish full-game support.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
